  </bpmn:collaboration>
  <bpmn:process id="PROCESS" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LANES">
      <bpmn:lane id="EC" name="EC">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>start</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>tell</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="INQ" name="INQ">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>notify</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="IP" name="IP">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>check</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>possible</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>confirm</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>reject</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>confirmed</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>rejected</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>
    <bpmn:startEvent id="start" name="Master data changed" />
    <bpmn:task id="tell" name="Tell the INQ about the change of master data" />
    <bpmn:task id="notify" name="Notify the IP of the change" />
    <bpmn:task id="check" name="Check whether the master data can be changed at the desired time" />
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="possible" name="Can master data be changed at the desired time?" />
    <bpmn:task id="confirm" name="Confirm the changes of the INQ" />
    <bpmn:task id="reject" name="Reject the changes of the INQ" />

    <bpmn:endEvent id="rejected" name="Changes rejected" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f1" sourceRef="start" targetRef="tell" />

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f3" sourceRef="notify" targetRef="check" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f4" sourceRef="check" targetRef="possible" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f5" name="yes" sourceRef="possible" targetRef="confirm" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f6" name="no" sourceRef="possible" targetRef="reject" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f7" sourceRef="confirm" targetRef="confirmed" />

  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
